products.label: A
products.reason: It is an email communication service for the same enterprise customers, but it adds outbound sending rather than the security and archiving functions offered before.

products.label: B
products.reason: It builds on the firm’s existing OCR-based document conversion work, extending it from fax-to-EDI into broader document capture and recognition.

products.label: C
products.reason: It stays in the same fax and email messaging domain and extends the company’s existing conversion services between communication formats.

products.label: D
products.reason: It is a feature enhancement for the company’s existing cloud fax service, aimed at improving a product it already offered to the same customers.

products.label: E
products.reason: It fits the firm’s existing managed email security offerings, adding sandbox-based malware analysis to the anti-spam and antivirus services.

products.label: F
products.reason: It is essentially the same kind of managed email antivirus protection the firm already provided, just with more advanced scanning.
